text.en:
Grants an extra Coldsnap Grenade Ability Charge.

Coldsnaps Grenades have better tracking, travel 35% further, and grant Grenade Ability upon hitting or freezing an enemy.

Grenade Ability Recharge:
11%: Tier 1 Rank-and-File
22%: Tier 2 Rank-and-File / Tier 1 Elite / Guardians
33%: Tier 3 Rank-and-File / Tier 2 Elite
50%: Tier 3 Elite / Minibosses / Champions / Bosses

For Combatant Classifications <link click here [https://d2clarity.page.link/combatant] />.

Grants an extra Coldsnap Grenade Ability Charge.

Coldsnaps Grenades have better tracking, travel 35% further, and grant Grenade Ability upon hitting or freezing an enemy.

Grenade Ability Energy gains based on <link enemy rank [https://d2clarity.page.link/combatant] />:
• 7%: Enemy Players
• 10%: Tier 1 Minors
• 22%: Tier 2 Minors, Tier 1 Elites
• 34%: Tier 3 Minors, Tier 2 Elites
• 50%: Tier 4 Minors, Tier 3-4 Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses

Grants <stasis/>Coldsnap Grenades an extra Ability Charge, better tracking, and 35% longer tracking length. 

Damaging an enemy with <stasis/>Coldsnap, <arc/>Storm, <strand/>Threadling, or <void/>Vortex Grenades grants Grenade Ability Energy.

<void/>Vortex Grenades have a 0.8 seconds cooldown between activations.

Healing allies with a <solar/>Healing Grenade grants 12% Grenade Ability Energy.

<stasis/>Coldsnap | {<arc/>Storm|<strand/>Threadling|<void/>Vortex} Grenade Energy gains based on <link enemy rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Enemy Players: 7% | 5%
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10% | 3%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 22% | 5.7%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 34% | 8.4%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 50% | 12%
